column4: OutboundFrame::committing_on_write attaches a delivery commit to fire when a sink writes the frame (MIK-7887.RECEIPT.3); receipt timing, no allow or deny.
OutboundFrame::stdio_written fires the frame's delivery commit and marks it and each batch item written after stdout took it; bookkeeping after the judge already ran.
StdioReads Debug prints only whether judging is on and holds no secret; formatting.
StdioReads::batch_of wraps already-judged batch items (each judged right after its own dispatch) in one unjudged batch frame and carries their holds; it judges nothing itself.
